candidates.summary: genesisApplied treats a failing stateDB.Has as 'genesis not applied', so a read error on restart sends a running chain through resetToGenesisDoc, which overwrites its persisted state record with the genesis state
candidates.failure_scenario: A node with 500 committed blocks restarts and stateDB.Has(abciResponsesKey:0) returns an error (I/O error, corruption). genesisApplied returns false, LoadStateFromDBOrGenesisDocProvider calls resetToGenesisDoc, and sm.SaveState persists LastBlockHeight=0 and an empty AppHash over the real record. The handshake then panics on StoreBlockHeight (500) > StateBlockHeight + 1 (1). Every later restart, after the read error has cleared, loads the overwritten record and panics the same way, so the operator has to repair the state DB by hand or resync. At the merge base the same restart keeps LastBlockHeight 500. Returning the error from genesisApplied, or treating an error as applied, stops this.
candidates.verify_by: Drop tests/solo-finder-1-has-error-resets-state.go into tm2/pkg/bft/node/ and run go test ./tm2/pkg/bft/node/ -run TestSoloFinder1_HasError -v -count=1. It wraps the DB so Has fails, after saving the height-0 responses and a state at height 500. Expect LastBlockHeight 500 to survive; at the head it reads 0, persisted.
candidates.evidence: head 4c61d0582: 'returned err=<nil> LastBlockHeight=0' / 'persisted after restart: LastBlockHeight=0 AppHash=""'; merge base cfcbaf484 node.go, same test: 'returned err=<nil> LastBlockHeight=500' / 'persisted after restart: LastBlockHeight=500 AppHash="committed-app-hash"'

candidates.summary: TestE2ERejectThenCorrectedGenesisBoots never restarts against the same data dir: cfg.ResetTestRoot gives DBBackend memdb, and DefaultDBProvider opens a fresh NewMemDB on every NewNode, so the second build starts empty and never reaches the reset branch
candidates.failure_scenario: Delete the 'if !genesisApplied(stateDB) { return resetToGenesisDoc(stateDB, freshDoc) }' block in node.go and the test stays green: build(1) finds no persisted genesis doc, takes the first-boot branch, and InitChain sees InitialHeight 1. Only the unit test TestLoadStateFromDBOrGenesisDocProvider_RejectedGenesisRetry pins the reset, and it never runs a handshake. The end-to-end reject-then-correct path the test header describes stays unpinned.
candidates.verify_by: Read: tm2/pkg/bft/config/toml.go:95 ResetTestRoot uses TestConfig(), config.go:334 sets DBBackend memdb, memdb's registered creator returns NewMemDB() per call, and node.go DefaultNewNodeWithGenesisProvider passes DefaultDBProvider. Mutation to confirm: remove node.go:1088-1090 and run go test ./tm2/pkg/bft/node -run TestE2ERejectThenCorrectedGenesisBoots; predicted green. Fix shape: set config.DBBackend to pebbledb, or pass a DBProvider that returns one shared memdb per ID across both builds.
